title: tclean statistics inside the primary beam for every gridder: the residual's pixel mask, the nsigma noise and the automatic mask
baseline_note: main before this change; the branch's base, 49c810c572, differs from it only in the simulation crates and CASA tool signatures, not in imaging
builds: release casars-imager of each revision in a private target directory (runs/pb-statistics/target-branch and target-base on the Mac); the casars Python package of the branch, installed from a wheel, drives both
driver: tools/casa-compat/tclean_case_matrix.py, each case's CASA calls in a CASA process of their own
limits: exact image-product inventory and masks; NRMS <= 1e-3, .sumwt within 5e-5; WCS, units, beams; exact iterdone/nmajordone/stopcode; maxpsfsidelobe and cyclethreshold 1e-4 relative plus 1e-8 absolute

outcome.summary: Of the seven new cases, five pass on the branch and fail at the baseline; point_automask_nsigma_negative_pblimit passes on both (it guards the negative-pblimit path); alma_standard_nsigma matches CASA's counts, cycles and products and misses one scalar by 2.2e-4 relative (attributed). The 39 regression cases pass but for the two recorded divergences.

alma_standard_nsigma.branch: counts (701, 11, 8), per-cycle iterations, nsigma thresholds and every product as CASA's; cyclethreshold 9.8894e-05 against 9.8916e-05 (2.2e-4 relative, limit 1e-4)
alma_standard_nsigma.baseline: fails: 839 iterations in 9 major cycles against CASA's 701 in 11; residual NRMS 0.27

point_standard_nsigma.baseline: fails: 797 iterations in 5 major cycles against 511 in 4; residual NRMS 0.18

point_standard_nsigma_robust.baseline: fails: 826 iterations in 5 major cycles against 613 in 4

point_cube_automask.branch: passes, every channel's .mask exact (#1074's channels 6, 17 and 18 included)

outcome.regression: 37/39 pass; test_iterbot_cube_nsigma.1 (residual NRMS 0.044 with exact counts: the recorded cube nsigma f32 floor) and test_multifield_facets_mfs.1 (2471 pixel-mask pixels on .image and .residual: the recorded CASA facet-mask bug) fail as round 5 recorded them
outcome.timing: single runs, not an A-B-B-A timing: point_cube_automask (1024 x 1024 x 20 channels, the analytic beam formed for every plane at every boundary) took 17.9 s native on the branch and 20.1 s at the baseline; no case ran measurably slower

attributions.alma_standard_nsigma: The scalar is CASA's cycle threshold after the last major cycle, the sidelobe level times the final peak residual of a noise-free field cleaned to 1e-4 of its dirty peak over eleven major cycles. Counts, cycle splits and nsigma thresholds agree exactly and every product within 1e-3, so the 2.2e-4 difference is the final residual's own precision (CASA's Float images against casa-rs's f64), not the beam statistics.
attributions.branch_first: In the first case versions, nsigma 3 never stopped the VLA runs and the default auto-multithresh parameters left the noise-free mosaic's masks to the sidelobe threshold. point_standard_nsigma and point_automask_nsigma_negative_pblimit then matched CASA's counts, cycle splits and nsigma thresholds exactly, and differed only after the last cycle cleaned 387 and 458 components to cycleniter at the noise floor (residual NRMS 0.012 and 0.0057), where near-equal peaks decide the order. The mosaic matched its statistics to the residual's 1e-4 precision, and one iteration moved at a near-tie threshold crossing in its third cycle (67 against 68). Without a mask, point_standard_nsigma_robust met the recorded CASA bug in which nothing is cleaned. The revised cases stop on nsigma, name a mask, and let the noise threshold set the mosaic's mask.

branch_first.note: the case file's first version; the cases revised afterwards (the nsigma and mosaic ones) are superseded by branch_revised and branch_mosaic

branch_revised.note: the revised nsigma cases, which stop on nsigma

branch_mosaic.note: the revised mosaic cases, whose noise threshold sets the mask

baseline.note: every case at the baseline; its mosaic rows are the first version's parameters

baseline_mosaic.note: the revised mosaic cases at the baseline

regression.note: the main matrix's NOW cases this change can reach: every standard or W-projection case cleaning an image whose corner lies past about 1000 arcsec, every NOW auto-multithresh and standard nsigma case, and one heterogeneous mosaic nsigma cube

archive.contents: every run directory (receipts, CASA and native products and logs, without the staged input MeasurementSets), the diagnostic verbose automask runs, the run scripts and both binaries
